result.title: Anchors That Move Without Collapsing: Exclusive-Region Anchor Routing for Vision Transformers
result.summary: Anchor tokens let a vision transformer exchange global information through a few summaries, but nothing forces different anchors to summarise different things. On one shared backbone we show that a Perceiver-style pathway and an AnchorFormer pathway collapse to a single summary, the latter despite its mass normalisation (pooling-map similarity 0.99), while other soft pathways, including Representative Attention, stay partly redundant (0.59-0.79). These results concern the routing modules inside our block, not the full published models. An exclusive partition of the patch grid cannot collapse by construction, and matched component by component it is 2.4-3.6 points more accurate than Representative Attention on CIFAR-100. We then propose focus anchors, which place most anchors at the peaks of a learned importance map while all anchors keep one exclusive Voronoi partition. Focus anchors beat a fixed partition on a cluttered canvas (+1.5 points, 95% CI [0.5, 2.6]) but not on full-HD traffic-sign recognition. There, both variants match dense attention with local windows at about a fifth of its FLOPs, and the fixed partition also trains 1.5x faster per step than dense attention with FlashAttention, though both use more memory; a ViT on a downsampled input loses half its mean average precision. Hard exclusive assignment is the only region assignment we tested that is both stable and most accurate: softmax and Sinkhorn relaxations diverge, and Gumbel-softmax trains but is less accurate. We also report the limits: a ResNet-18 is more accurate on every task we trained it on in this from-scratch regime, and anchors train faster than FlashAttention only from about 1536x1536 pixels and never use less memory.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察 ViT 中 anchor token 路由的多样性问题：发现 Perceiver 式与 AnchorFormer 路径会坍缩为单一摘要，而按互斥 Voronoi 区域做硬分配不会结构性坍缩，并提出把 anchor 放在重要性图峰值上的 focus anchors，在分类任务上比较精度、FLOPs 与内存。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「池化图相似度」式 anchor 坍缩诊断与互斥硬分配（对比 softmax、Sinkhorn、Gumbel 方案）可能可供核查 LVR 中多个 latent 摘要保持区分、视觉证据分区与路由稳定性；但该工作属分类骨干的效率研究，不涉及推理状态生成与答案使用，迁移性需评估。
